name: EgoTempo
intro: EgoTempo是一个面向自我中心视频时序理解的500题开放式问答基准。它从Ego4D带时间戳叙述推导视频片段，用Gemini 1.5 Pro辅助生成问答，再通过逐片段人工复核与单帧可答性门禁，要求保留的问题确实依赖多帧时序证据。
build_method: Ego4D叙述窗口与片段合并, Gemini 1.5 Pro描述及十类开放问答生成, 人工视频复核, 单帧捷径过滤
modality: 视频, 文本, 多模态
eval_feature: 10类能力各50题, 纯文本/中心帧/均匀多帧受控对照, 论文使用Gemini 1.5 Pro评审
scale: 论文：500个问答对、365个片段、221段源视频、40个场景；固定v1.0 JSON：500行、367个唯一clip_id、222个唯一video_uid
build_method_en: Ego4D narration windows and clip grouping, Gemini 1.5 Pro captioning and ten-category OpenQA generation, manual video review, single-frame shortcut filtering
eval_feature_en: 50 questions in each of ten capabilities, controlled text/central-frame/uniform-multiframe comparison, paper protocol uses a Gemini 1.5 Pro judge
intro_en: EgoTempo is a 500-item open-ended benchmark for temporal understanding in egocentric video. It derives clips from timestamped Ego4D narrations, uses Gemini 1.5 Pro to assist QA generation, and then applies clip-grounded manual review plus a single-frame answerability gate so retained questions require multiframe temporal evidence.

drawio_review_note: Evidence is frozen to arXiv:2503.13646v1 (PDF SHA-256 2fdcd2779bced864cfaef7e7e3181b964ae2c6dac49666b4c88901eacda0c32d), official repo commit 7022ba77b4d89f51cf34e499767995ccd5c90c7a, and egotempo_openQA.json dataset v1.0 (SHA-256 adc9e7d5b1075a46e2648d4e34260b41d26b8c6e339159b3746a3fe7fdf94eaf). Sections 3.1–4.3 support the narration window Tj = tj ± βi/(2α), grouping up to 120 narrations or 120 seconds, Gemini 1.5 Pro captioning and ten-category QA generation, multiframe/logical-consistency manual checks, single-frame answerability rejection, central-frame and uniform multiframe controls, Gemini 1.5 Pro judging, accuracy, and Accuracy(S)/single-frame gain. The paper reports 500 QA / 365 clips / 221 videos / 40 scenarios, whereas the pinned v1.0 JSON contains 500 rows / 367 unique clip_id / 222 unique video_uid; this release-count drift is explicitly shown rather than merged into the paper statistics. The paper does not disclose which frame is used in the curation shortcut gate. The pinned notebook currently defaults its inference and judge MODEL_NAME to gemini-1.5-flash, so the diagram follows the paper's Pro judge and separately labels that repository divergence. MultiQA is excluded because it is not the EgoTempo scoring path.
